desc: The guest swaps its partner at once and the host's game makes the swap: in Rogueport's plaza with Goombella and Koops in the party, under a 150 ms simulated round trip, the guest (seat 2) presses R: Koops is its partner on its own screen in the frame of the press (0 frames), the swap goes to the host as an action, the host's game swaps to Koops (the quick swap's way) and answers, and the guest's partner stays Koops (never put back to the host's Goombella meanwhile)

log_must: fieldact: player 2's swap #\d+ \(2\): begun here, watched
co-op: this guest walks its own character \(seat 2\)
fieldact: swap #\d+ \(seat 2, 2\) shown here 0 frames after its press
\[coop\] this guest's partner is 2 here at once
fieldact: the host's word on swap #\d+: done \(swapped\)
log_must_not: fieldact: the host's word on swap #\d+: refused
co-op: this guest's partner is the host's \(1\) again
